# Tier 4: Graduation

- [ ] Property tax fund holds at least one full year's bill before any resident fee starts, and the fee starts only if the exemption is denied or lapses
- [ ] Community has mentored at least one new group starting at Tier 0
- [ ] Lessons from this community's founding years and later growth added back into the handbook
